prompts.packet:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create realistic, production-quality original SaaS website art direction, strong typography, purposeful spacing, premium human-designed composition. One independent visual direction named "Packet Atelier" for DrawPacket. Target dimensions 1440 wide × 1600 tall, vertical design presentation. Upper 1100px is a polished desktop marketing website hero and start of its product chapter; bottom 500px is an understated art-direction strip with palette swatches and three motion storyboard frames for THIS SAME direction, not alternative designs. The title Packet Atelier belongs only to the lower art-direction strip.

DrawPacket is a research-stage concept for general contractor project accountants reviewing subcontractor draws. Current date 15 October 2026; scenario dates fixed: September 2026 pay period, review 5 Oct 2026, COI expires 8 Oct and intended review date 10 Oct. Synthetic records ONLY. Top navigation original compact packet-tab mark and "DrawPacket", links "Offerings", "How it works", "Controls", small primary "Explore demo". Visible small line "CONCEPT PREVIEW · SYNTHETIC DATA". Hero heading exactly "Make one GC draw ready." supporting sentence "Visible holds. Traceable evidence. A reviewer at every decision." Editorial serif heading around 78px, neutral sans UI 15–17px, tabular monospace IDs/amounts. Third font allowed specifically for numbers. Near black #242821 text, warm white #F6F3ED page, olive #536449 action, clay redline #A34C36, manila #E8D5A8 restricted to folder tabs/edge accents, amber #F2A900 only hold labels with warning icon and text.

Asymmetric editorial hero: large heading upper left with generously spaced Explore synthetic demo button and Discuss a pilot text link; integrated large open folder/review packet occupying right half and continuing into lower hero. Mainly warm-white sheets, MANILA TABS read "SOV", "CO", "Waiver", "COI", "Approval". Folder has carefully drawn physical edge and slight angled opening but its financial sheet is face-on and fully legible. No decorative desk objects. Main invented record "Bridgepine Builders / BP-04", "Stoneway Mechanical", "PA-07". Three perfectly aligned ledger columns "Requested $84,000", "Supported $78,000", "Variance $6,000". A red editorial correction outline circles only "$6,000" with a thin source annotation. Source lines: "SOV current work $65,000", "Stored materials $5,000", "Approved CO-03 $8,000". An attached small amber hold tag says "Missing lower-tier waiver" with warning icon, second row "COI expires 08 Oct", bottom "Mara Ellis · Reviewer" and "GC approval pending". Clearly "DEMO — SYNTHETIC DATA" on product sheet. Footer line inside sheet "No signing or payment execution". No payment-complete status.
Lower start-of-chapter treatment uses bold small "A number is only as strong as its evidence." beside a cropped source-document detail, generous spacing and elegant thin rules.
Bottom direction strip: named "Packet Atelier / Folder tabs & redlines", exact palette swatches, serif Aa / sans Aa / mono 07 specimen, three clean mini-frames labelled "Assemble once", "Trace the variance", "Attach the hold", showing different stages of SAME folder story. Small note "Scroll chapters 03 & 05 pin · Reduced motion: complete still".
No oversized stamp, typewriter masthead, bone parchment, distressed/grunge texture, cranes, stock photos, AI orbs, purple gradients, generic bento cards, fake customer logos, ROI claims, real bank/ERP logos, browser/device bezel. The focus is one beautiful hero with coherent real-looking financial evidence, not a dashboard feature inventory. Generous whitespace, precise alignment, few borders, sparing soft shadows only on paper edges. Render all critical copy accurately.
prompts.field:

Create realistic, production-quality UI design with clear hierarchy, strong typography, intentional spacing and impeccable alignment. Target 1440 wide × 1600 tall art-direction board. No browser/device bezel. This must look practical, architectural, site-aware and expensive.

The user is a general contractor project accountant/payment administrator. This is an unbuilt research-stage concept. Visible "CONCEPT PREVIEW · SYNTHETIC DATA". Current date 15 October 2026; use fictional September draw, review 5 Oct 2026, COI expiry 8 Oct before intended date 10 Oct 2026. Main record Bridgepine Builders BP-04 / Stoneway Mechanical PA-07. Gross requested $84,000; supported $78,000; variance $6,000. Support equals $65,000 current work + $5,000 stored materials + $8,000 approved CO-03. Missing lower-tier conditional waiver. COI expiry flag. Reviewer Mara Ellis; GC approval pending. No real customer, bank, ERP or insurer logos. No payment release, guaranteed savings or production product claims. Every product view labelled DEMO.

Design strategy: wide horizontal construction register, graph-paper engineering precision WITHOUT wallpaper grids. Mineral grey #E4E6E3 hero surface, white register, graphite #2B2F33 type, restrained safety orange #E8641B ONLY for hold/exception labels with icon and text. Thin blueprint-blue leader lines ONLY for source references. Dark graphite primary CTA (not orange). Sturdy architectural grotesque headline, clean sans body 15–17px, mono coordinates/IDs, tabular financial numerals. Crisp 1px hairlines, square edges, no rounded-card grid, no folder, no stamp, no serif, no paper texture. Generous whitespace.

Layout: slim top original register-style mark and DrawPacket wordmark, nav Offerings / How it works / Controls / Explore demo. Broad horizontal heading "Every draw.\nEvery exception.\nIn view." aligned at upper left in confident 76px medium-weight grotesque with controlled spacing. At upper right a short 3-line note exactly "A concept for reviewing pay applications, supporting evidence and named approvals." and two clear actions "Explore synthetic demo" and "Discuss a pilot". Below, one full-bleed wide register stretching nearly entire width. Column labels RECORD / REQUESTED / SUPPORTED / VARIANCE / REVIEW STATUS. One expanded main row PA-07, Stoneway Mechanical, $84,000, $78,000, $6,000 with fine numbered annotation bubbles 01,02,03. Under it a narrow evidence register: 01 SOV + approved CO / 02 Conditional waiver missing / 03 COI expires 08 Oct. Short blueprint blue leaders connect source references without crossing text. Holds orange text with warning icon; approval pending graphite. Small named reviewer and "No signing or payment execution".
Next chapter is a crisp two-column architectural detail crop: heading "Follow the source." and original synthetic SOV snippet annotated to CO-03 and PA-07. Caption "Illustrative evidence review. Human approval required." Use only supplied copy, NO invented claims or metrics. One broad system surface, not lots of little boxes.
Bottom labeled "Field Register / Engineering annotations" with exact palette swatches, type specimen, and mini-frames "Align the rows" / "Trace the source" / "Record the review". Include terse "Scroll-led alignment · Fine source leaders · Reduced-motion still". These are static storyboard stages, no suggestion animation actually plays. Human-made detail and sharp typographic rhythm.
prompts.gallery:

DrawPacket is a research-stage construction draw-review concept for GC project accountants. Current date 15 October 2026; fictional pay period September 2026, review snapshot 5 Oct 2026, COI expires 8 Oct before intended review date 10 Oct. Every evidence view says "DEMO — SYNTHETIC DATA". Top status "CONCEPT PREVIEW". No product availability, guaranteed outcome, customer or integration claim. No testimonials, logos or payment activity. Use ONLY supplied marketing words, don't invent paragraphs.

Visual vocabulary: crisp white #FFFFFF, near-black #242124, deep aubergine #4A2F45 for identity/CTA, very soft grey rules #DDDCDE, amber #F2A900 and clay #A34C36 for status with text/icons. Refined editorial serif in 70px headings; neutral sans body around16px, tabular figures. Flat sophisticated exhibits, generous whitespace, exquisite optical alignment. No folder/manila, no grain, no heavy engineering table, no big stamp, no purple gradients, no shadows around every pane, no fintech metric cards. A few open document excerpts are displayed as numbered exhibits, not floating rounded cards.

Layout: compact DrawPacket original bracketed-page mark upper left; navigation Offerings / How it works / Controls at right and aubergine Explore demo button. Upper hero uses elegantly offset left-aligned two-line heading "Every amount,\nwith its evidence." paired with restrained right paragraph exactly "Explore a concept for reviewing one draw, its supporting documents and the decisions still needed." Below headline Explore synthetic demo + Discuss a pilot links. Under this, a dramatic asymmetrical gallery arrangement with one CENTRAL elongated PA-07 record strip at midheight spanning 750px. Clearly read: "Bridgepine Builders · BP-04" / "Stoneway Mechanical · PA-07"; "Requested $84,000" / "Supported $78,000" / "Variance $6,000". Small "Held for review" clay label and warning icon.
Arrange three original source snippets with substantial whitespace around that central record: upper-left exhibit "A / SOV-07 · v3" with "30 Sep 2026 · Lines 23–24", "Current work $65,000" and "Stored materials $5,000"; upper-right exhibit "B / CO-03 · v1", "Approved 28 Sep 2026", "$8,000"; lower-left exhibit "C / Waiver & COI", warning "Lower-tier conditional waiver missing", "COI expires 08 Oct". Fine subtle aubergine/grey leader lines connect EACH source to its relevant amount/record; terminate accurately at edges and never cross text. Small marker on record reveals an open evidence drawer on the far right: "Source / Version / Date / Line", and "Mara Ellis · Reviewer", "GC approval pending", "No signing or payment execution". Ensure document amounts sum $65k+$5k+$8k=$78k, variance84-78=6k. Sources are inspectable-looking, not real external documents. Avoid giant overlapping windows. Let the record and evidence feel like an authored exhibit.
Start next narrative chapter with large serif "See what supports the draw." and a thin indexed provenance rail, no filler prose.
Bottom white art-direction strip separated by rule: "Evidence Gallery / A central record, an open evidence trail", exact labeled palette, serif/sans figure specimens and three small static frames "Place the evidence", "Connect to PA-07", "Open the source". Note "Scroll-led panes · Fine leader lines · Drawer without bounce". No multiple options in one image. Prioritize a striking editorial composition and legible financial hierarchy, use spacing and typography rather than nested cards.
